title: Federal Cryptographic Trust Stack
question: How do authoritative source records, identity proofing, signed claims, key and issuer trust, authorization, audit and post-quantum migration form a durable federal trust stack?
bluf: The federal trust stack is a federation of authoritative records, scoped identity proofing, signed claims, issuer-key registries, local authorization, accountable signatures, audit, correction and revocation. PQC preserves cryptographic durability; it does not make a claim true or authorize an action.
